All five findings are fixed on the current head (`67e2c4590`) and verified red-before/green-after by the regression guards.

## 🚨 BLOCKING #1 — `release-dedupe` red on every run (script invoked without a checkout) — FIXED

`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `release-dedupe` job: an **unconditional** blobless `actions/checkout` now precedes the check step:

```yaml
- uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
  with:
    fetch-depth: 1
    filter: blob:none # the check never reads blobs — one gh run list
- id: check
  ...
  run: bash scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh
```

- Repo-wide pinned SHA, shallow + blobless (seconds inside the 5-minute budget).
- **Unconditional on purpose**: the `check` step has no job-level `if` (a skipped pre-check would empty its output), so the checkout runs on every arm — a release-gated checkout would re-create exit 127 on exactly the `workflow_dispatch` arm your log showed.
- The wrong "no checkout, no actions" invariant comment is replaced: `release-pending` stays checkout-free only because its logic is **inline**; this check is a repo file, and inlining it would orphan the fixture-self-tested script — the extracted script stays the single source of truth that `scripts/release_dedupe_selftest.sh` exercises.

## 🚨 BLOCKING #2 — any-status dedupe (fail-open) — FIXED, fail-closed

`scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh` uses your "simplest and strictly safe" variant — **dedupe only on `conclusion == "success"`**:

```bash
--json createdAt,conclusion,status \
--jq '.[] | select(.conclusion == "success") | .createdAt'
```

- A failed/cancelled push run now yields **no dedupe candidate** → `dedupe=false` → the release twin re-runs the full gate, goes red on the same commit and attaches nothing — the pre-PR invariant ("the explicit gate check keeps failed-gate runs from building publishable binaries", gh-1537/gh-1172 gate-before-publish) restored.
- Behind the shared `ci-<ref>` concurrency group (`cancel-in-progress: false`, tag runs never cancelled) the push twin is already **completed** when the release twin's check executes, so success-only is strictly safe; any other outcome degrades to the AC2 full-gate safety net.
- AC5 fail-safe unchanged on top: an API error still warns (`::warning::`) and degrades to `dedupe=false`.

## ⚠️ IMPORTANT — the guard pinned the broken shape — FIXED

`test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart` no longer asserts `hasLength(1)` steps + `uses isNull`. It now pins the **working** contract: exactly one `actions/checkout` step (`hasLength(1)` over checkout steps, with the af1396d3 exit-127 failure as the reason), **unconditional** (`if` pinned null), ordered **before** the check step, `fetch-depth: 1` + `filter: blob:none`.

## 💡 Suggestion — `isNot(contains('--status'))` pin — FIXED

Deleted; replaced with a positive pin of the fail-closed projection on the real surface: `contains('--json createdAt,conclusion,status')` + `contains('select(.conclusion == "success")')`, with the corrected concurrency model in the reason text (push twin completed, never `in_progress`, behind the `ci-<ref>` queue). Behavioral twin: `scripts/release_dedupe_selftest.sh` gained fail-closed fixtures — `failure` / `cancelled` / `in_progress` / failure-among-stale-green → `dedupe=false` (24/24 green; red against the pre-fix script).

## 💡 Suggestion — "ONLY the binaries-attach leg" comment — FIXED

Every overstated comment (workflow header, trigger comment, job comment, script `::notice::`, guard docstrings) now matches the real graph: **every gate leg skips; binaries, release-provenance and installer-smoke still run on the deduped twin; web-spa/publish stay keyed on the quality-gate result and skip with it**. New guard test pins it: `release-provenance` and `installer-smoke` keep their release reachability with **no** dedupe clause, `web-spa` stays keyed on `needs.quality-gate.result == 'success'`.

dart test test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart test/ci_release_pending_guard_test.dart  # ✅ 22 passed
dart test                                                                  # ✅ full suite (see rework summary)
```

{"content":"# gh-1625 rework — all 12 open threads closed: verification pass on the rework head

## Issues/Notes

This rework leg continued the loop already fixed on head `67e2c4590` ("gh-1625 rework: release-dedupe checkout + conclusion-aware fail-closed dedupe"). The 12 open threads at rework start are: 1 aggregate automated review (REQUEST_CHANGES — 2 BLOCKING, 1 IMPORTANT, 2 suggestions) plus 11 machine audit/status records. **Every finding was verified against the tree, mutation-probed to prove the guards catch the flagged regressions, and the full suite was run on the final head.** No new code defects surfaced, so no further commit was needed — the open threads were loop bookkeeping on an already-fixed head (one earlier validation dispatch was lost to gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

Findings → verification (all fixed on `67e2c4590`):

1. 🚨 **BLOCKING #1 — `release-dedupe` exits 127 on every run (no checkout).** Verified present in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: an **unconditional** `actions/checkout@3d3c42e5…` (repo-wide pinned SHA, `fetch-depth: 1`, `filter: blob:none`) now precedes `run: bash scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh`. Unconditional on purpose: the `check` step has no job-level `if`, so a release-gated checkout would re-create exit 127 on the `workflow_dispatch` arm seen in runs 38696670029/38696668627.
2. 🚨 **BLOCKING #2 — any-status dedupe (fail-open).** Verified in `scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh`: the lookup fetches `--json createdAt,conclusion,status` and projects `select(.conclusion == "success")` — **only a GREEN push gate dedupes**; a failed/cancelled push run degrades to the AC2 full-gate safety net (the twin re-gates, goes red, attaches nothing). # gh-1625 rework — all 12 open threads closed: verification pass on the rework head

## Issues/Notes

This rework leg continued the loop already fixed on head `67e2c4590` ("gh-1625 rework: release-dedupe checkout + conclusion-aware fail-closed dedupe"). The 12 open threads at rework start are: 1 aggregate automated review (REQUEST_CHANGES — 2 BLOCKING, 1 IMPORTANT, 2 suggestions) plus 11 machine audit/status records. **Every finding was verified against the tree, mutation-probed to prove the guards catch the flagged regressions, and the full suite was run on the final head.** No new code defects surfaced, so no further commit was needed — the open threads were loop bookkeeping on an already-fixed head (one earlier validation dispatch was lost to gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

Findings → verification (all fixed on `67e2c4590`):

1. 🚨 **BLOCKING #1 — `release-dedupe` exits 127 on every run (no checkout).** Verified present in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: an **unconditional** `actions/checkout@3d3c42e5…` (repo-wide pinned SHA, `fetch-depth: 1`, `filter: blob:none`) now precedes `run: bash scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh`. Unconditional on purpose: the `check` step has no job-level `if`, so a release-gated checkout would re-create exit 127 on the `workflow_dispatch` arm seen in runs 38696670029/38696668627.
2. 🚨 **BLOCKING #2 — any-status dedupe (fail-open).** Verified in `scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh`: the lookup fetches `--json createdAt,conclusion,status` and projects `select(.conclusion == "success")` — **only a GREEN push gate dedupes**; a failed/cancelled push run degrades to the AC2 full-gate safety net (the twin re-gates, goes red, attaches nothing). AC5 unchanged on top: API error → `::warning::` + `dedupe=false`, never a skipped gate; the script never exits non-zero.
3. ⚠️ **IMPORTANT — the guard pinned the broken shape.** Verified `test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart` no longer asserts `steps hasLength(1)` + `uses isNull`; it now pins exactly one `actions/checkout` step, unconditional, ordered before the check step, shallow + blobless.
4. 💡 **Suggestion — `isNot(contains('--status'))` pin.** Replaced by a positive pin of the fail-closed projection (`contains('--json createdAt,conclusion,status')` + `contains('select(.conclusion == "success")')`) with the corrected concurrency model (push twin completed, never `in_progress`, behind the `ci-<ref>` queue).
5. 💡 **Suggestion — "ONLY the binaries-attach leg" comment overstated.** All comments (workflow header, trigger, job, script `::notice::`) now say: every gate leg skips; binaries, `release-provenance` and `installer-smoke` still run on the deduped twin; `web-spa`/`publish` stay keyed on the quality-gate result. A guard test pins `release-provenance`/`installer-smoke` reachable with **no** dedupe clause.

Note on `outputs/review_replies.json`: every open thread in `pr_discussions_raw.json` exposes `threadId: null` / `rootCommentId: null` (copied verbatim — this PR surface exposes no resolvable IDs), so entries carry `null`; the reply files are written per thread regardless.

## Approach

1. Read the full review thread set (`pr_discussions_raw.json` — 12 open threads) and mapped each finding to the tree at head `67e2c4590`.
2. **Verified, not assumed** — read the shipped shapes directly: `release-dedupe` job (checkout present, unconditional, before the check step), dedupe script (conclusion-aware, fail-closed, AC2/AC3/AC5 paths), `binaries` dedupe arm (safe: gated on `dedupe == 'true'`, reachable only on a GREEN push gate), `release-provenance`/`installer-smoke` (release-reachable, no dedupe clause), `web-spa` (keyed on the gate result). `ci.yml` parses as valid YAML.
3. **Mutation-probed the guards (TDD proof)**: temporarily re-created each flagged defect and confirmed the suite goes red —
   - removed the checkout step → guard fails with the exact "exit 127" reason (BLOCKING #1 pin live);
   - dropped the `conclusion == "success"` filter from the script → selftest 5 assertions red + guard "conclusion-aware" test red (BLOCKING #2 pin live);
   - restored both files from backup afterward — tree identical to HEAD (`git status` clean, `git diff --check` clean).
4. Ran the full verification battery on the frozen final tree (see Test Coverage).

## Files Modified

None in this leg — all fixes were already committed on the rework head this pass verified (threads are open only as loop bookkeeping):

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — (head `67e2c4590`) unconditional blobless checkout in `release-dedupe`; comments aligned to the real deduped-twin graph.
- `scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh` — (head `67e2c4590`) conclusion-aware, fail-closed lookup (`select(.conclusion == "success")`).
- `scripts/release_dedupe_selftest.sh` — (head `67e2c4590`) fail-closed fixtures: `failure`/`cancelled`/`in_progress`/failure-among-stale-green → `dedupe=false`; lookup-shape pins; AC2/AC3/AC5 fixtures.
- `test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart` — (head `67e2c4590`) pins the working checkout contract + the fail-closed projection; no more broken-shape/`--status` pins.
- `outputs/response.md`, `outputs/review_replies.json`, `outputs/review_replies/thread_{6,7,9,10,13,14,16,18,20,22,24,26}.md` — this leg's deliverables.

## Test Coverage

- `bash scripts/release_dedupe_selftest.sh` — ✅ green (AC1 fresh-GREEN dedupe; FC fail-closed `failure`/`cancelled`/`in_progress`/mixed-red → `dedupe=false`; AC2 window-edge/old-tag/no-push-run → `dedupe=false`; AC3 push/schedule/dispatch arms dedupe=false with **zero** `gh` calls and exit 0; AC5 API failure → `::warning::` + `dedupe=false` + exit 0; lookup shape + output-file purity pinned).
- `dart test test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart test/ci_release_pending_guard_test.dart` — ✅ **22 passed** (job shape: exactly-one-unconditional-checkout-before-check, shallow+blobless; gate chain `pending == 'true' && dedupe != 'true'` across all 30 gate legs; binaries release arm; pre-check jobs excluded from the gate closure; deduped-twin release legs keep no dedupe clause; selftest wiring).
- `dart test` (full suite, bare) — run 2× in the background on the final head (`sh-21-hn8crkhd5x1i0kwo0`, `sh-41-hn8dp8sfxgftz3pk`, full logs retained). Outcome per run: every non-integration test ✅; the only failures are **environmental, proven by exact base-parity** —
  - 14 failures in `test/integration/` (headless fa-session tests: `headless_log_file`, `headless_tools_flag`, `backend_mode_cli`, `job_board_stability_pty`, `yolo_rm_critical_e2e`). Re-ran the same 5 files in isolation: **HEAD 4 passed / 14 failed; a pristine `main` worktree (base `0eeba37d9`) in the same environment: 4 passed / 14 failed — identical**. The headless fa sessions spawned by these tests collide with the live fa agent session sharing this runner; the PR diff (CI YAML + 2 bash scripts + 2 static YAML-pinning dart tests) touches no runtime code.
  - 5 failures in `test/browser_ext/` — out of the per-PR suite's scope by design (`dart_test.yaml`: browser-ext runs only in the dedicated `browser-ext.yml` workflow that builds `sw/agent.js` and supplies Chrome for Testing; neither exists on this runner).
  - Both runs also died at VM **teardown** with a native `malloc_consolidate(): unaligned fastbin chunk detected` abort (SIGABRT 134) after the last test, before the summary line — no failing test involved; the diff contains no Dart/native code, and the repo's own CI on this exact head is fully green (see below), which runs the integration suite properly sharded (`pty-integration-linux`, `--concurrency=4`).
  - **Canonical verdict**: `input/pr-1627/ci_failures.md` (written by rework setup) — "All CI checks passed on the rework head", i.e. the full gated suite on head `67e2c4590` — `static`, `pty-integration-linux`, `coverage-gate`, `guards`, et al. — is green.
- Mutation probes — ✅ both flagged defects re-created → guards red; reverted; final tree byte-identical to HEAD (`git status` clean, `git diff --check` clean).

# gh-1625 rework — all 12 open threads closed: verification pass on the rework head

## Issues/Notes

This rework leg continued the loop already fixed on head `67e2c4590` ("gh-1625 rework: release-dedupe checkout + conclusion-aware fail-closed dedupe"). The 12 open threads at rework start are: 1 aggregate automated review (REQUEST_CHANGES — 2 BLOCKING, 1 IMPORTANT, 2 suggestions) plus 11 machine audit/status records. **Every finding was verified against the tree, mutation-probed to prove the guards catch the flagged regressions, and the full suite was run on the final head.** No new code defects surfaced, so no further commit was needed — the open threads were loop bookkeeping on an already-fixed head (one earlier validation dispatch was lost to gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

Findings → verification (all fixed on `67e2c4590`):

1. 🚨 **BLOCKING #1 — `release-dedupe` exits 127 on every run (no checkout).** Verified present in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: an **unconditional** `actions/checkout@3d3c42e5…` (repo-wide pinned SHA, `fetch-depth: 1`, `filter: blob:none`) now precedes `run: bash scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh`. Unconditional on purpose: the `check` step has no job-level `if`, so a release-gated checkout would re-create exit 127 on the `workflow_dispatch` arm seen in runs 38696670029/38696668627.
2. 🚨 **BLOCKING #2 — any-status dedupe (fail-open).** Verified in `scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh`: the lookup fetches `--json createdAt,conclusion,status` and projects `select(.conclusion == "success")` — **only a GREEN push gate dedupes**; a failed/cancelled push run degrades to the AC2 full-gate safety net (the twin re-gates, goes red, attaches nothing). AC5 unchanged on top: API error → `::warning::` + `dedupe=false`, never a skipped gate; the script never exits non-zero.
3. ⚠️ **IMPORTANT — the guard pinned the broken shape.** Verified `test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart` no longer asserts `steps hasLength(1)` + `uses isNull`; it now pins exactly one `actions/checkout` step, unconditional, ordered before the check step, shallow + blobless.
4. 💡 **Suggestion — `isNot(contains('--status'))` pin.** Replaced by a positive pin of the fail-closed projection (`contains('--json createdAt,conclusion,status')` + `contains('select(.conclusion == "success")')`) with the corrected concurrency model (push twin completed, never `in_progress`, behind the `ci-<ref>` queue).
5. 💡 **Suggestion — "ONLY the binaries-attach leg" comment overstated.** All comments (workflow header, trigger, job, script `::notice::`) now say: every gate leg skips; binaries, `release-provenance` and `installer-smoke` still run on the deduped twin; `web-spa`/`publish` stay keyed on the quality-gate result. A guard test pins `release-provenance`/`installer-smoke` reachable with **no** dedupe clause.

Note on `outputs/review_replies.json`: every open thread in `pr_discussions_raw.json` exposes `threadId: null` / `rootCommentId: null` (copied verbatim — this PR surface exposes no resolvable IDs), so entries carry `null`; the reply files are written per thread regardless.

## Approach

1. Read the full review thread set (`pr_discussions_raw.json` — 12 open threads) and mapped each finding to the tree at head `67e2c4590`.
2. **Verified, not assumed** — read the shipped shapes directly: `release-dedupe` job (checkout present, unconditional, before the check step), dedupe script (conclusion-aware, fail-closed, AC2/AC3/AC5 paths), `binaries` dedupe arm (safe: gated on `dedupe == 'true'`, reachable only on a GREEN push gate), `release-provenance`/`installer-smoke` (release-reachable, no dedupe clause), `web-spa` (keyed on the gate result). `ci.yml` parses as valid YAML.
3. **Mutation-probed the guards (TDD proof)**: temporarily re-created each flagged defect and confirmed the suite goes red —
   - removed the checkout step → guard fails with the exact "exit 127" reason (BLOCKING #1 pin live);
   - dropped the `conclusion == "success"` filter from the script → selftest 5 assertions red + guard "conclusion-aware" test red (BLOCKING #2 pin live);
   - restored both files from backup afterward — tree identical to HEAD (`git status` clean, `git diff --check` clean).
4. Ran the full verification battery on the frozen final tree (see Test Coverage).

## Files Modified

None in this leg — all fixes were already committed on the rework head this pass verified (threads are open only as loop bookkeeping):

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — (head `67e2c4590`) unconditional blobless checkout in `release-dedupe`; comments aligned to the real deduped-twin graph.
- `scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh` — (head `67e2c4590`) conclusion-aware, fail-closed lookup (`select(.conclusion == "success")`).
- `scripts/release_dedupe_selftest.sh` — (head `67e2c4590`) fail-closed fixtures: `failure`/`cancelled`/`in_progress`/failure-among-stale-green → `dedupe=false`; lookup-shape pins; AC2/AC3/AC5 fixtures.

Re-ran the same 5 files in isolation: **HEAD 4 passed / 14 failed; a pristine `main` worktree (base `0eeba37d9`) in the same environment: 4 passed / 14 failed — identical**. The headless fa sessions spawned by these tests collide with the live fa agent session sharing this runner; the PR diff (CI YAML + 2 bash scripts + 2 static YAML-pinning dart tests) touches no runtime code.

# gh-1625 rework — all 12 open threads closed: verification pass on the rework head

## Issues/Notes

This rework leg continued the loop already fixed on head `67e2c4590` ("gh-1625 rework: release-dedupe checkout + conclusion-aware fail-closed dedupe"). The 12 open threads at rework start are: 1 aggregate automated review (REQUEST_CHANGES — 2 BLOCKING, 1 IMPORTANT, 2 suggestions) plus 11 machine audit/status records. **Every finding was verified against the tree, mutation-probed to prove the guards catch the flagged regressions, and the full suite was run on the final head.** No new code defects surfaced, so no further commit was needed — the open threads were loop bookkeeping on an already-fixed head (one earlier validation dispatch was lost to gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

Findings → verification (all fixed on `67e2c4590`):

1. 🚨 **BLOCKING #1 — `release-dedupe` exits 127 on every run (no checkout).** Verified present in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: an **unconditional** `actions/checkout@3d3c42e5…` (repo-wide pinned SHA, `fetch-depth: 1`, `filter: blob:none`) now precedes `run: bash scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh`. Unconditional on purpose: the `check` step has no job-level `if`, so a release-gated checkout would re-create exit 127 on the `workflow_dispatch` arm seen in runs 38696670029/38696668627.
2. 🚨 **BLOCKING #2 — any-status dedupe (fail-open).** Verified in `scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh`: the lookup fetches `--json createdAt,conclusion,status` and projects `select(.conclusion == "success")` — **only a GREEN push gate dedupes**; a failed/cancelled push run degrades to the AC2 full-gate safety net (the twin re-gates, goes red, attaches nothing). AC5 unchanged on top: API error → `::warning::` + `dedupe=false`, never a skipped gate; the script never exits non-zero.
3. ⚠️ **IMPORTANT — the guard pinned the broken shape.** Verified `test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart` no longer asserts `steps hasLength(1)` + `uses isNull`; it now pins exactly one `actions/checkout` step, unconditional, ordered before the check step, shallow + blobless.
4. 💡 **Suggestion — `isNot(contains('--status'))` pin.** Replaced by a positive pin of the fail-closed projection (`contains('--json createdAt,conclusion,status')` + `contains('select(.conclusion == "success")')`) with the corrected concurrency model (push twin completed, never `in_progress`, behind the `ci-<ref>` queue).
5. 💡 **Suggestion — "ONLY the binaries-attach leg" comment overstated.** All comments (workflow header, trigger, job, script `::notice::`) now say: every gate leg skips; binaries, `release-provenance` and `installer-smoke` still run on the deduped twin; `web-spa`/`publish` stay keyed on the quality-gate result. A guard test pins `release-provenance`/`installer-smoke` reachable with **no** dedupe clause.

Note on `outputs/review_replies.json`: every open thread in `pr_discussions_raw.json` exposes `threadId: null` / `rootCommentId: null` (copied verbatim — this PR surface exposes no resolvable IDs), so entries carry `null`; the reply files are written per thread regardless.

## Approach

1. Read the full review thread set (`pr_discussions_raw.json` — 12 open threads) and mapped each finding to the tree at head `67e2c4590`.
2. **Verified, not assumed** — read the shipped shapes directly: `release-dedupe` job (checkout present, unconditional, before the check step), dedupe script (conclusion-aware, fail-closed, AC2/AC3/AC5 paths), `binaries` dedupe arm (safe: gated on `dedupe == 'true'`, reachable only on a GREEN push gate), `release-provenance`/`installer-smoke` (release-reachable, no dedupe clause), `web-spa` (keyed on the gate result). `ci.yml` parses as valid YAML.
3. **Mutation-probed the guards (TDD proof)**: temporarily re-created each flagged defect and confirmed the suite goes red —
   - removed the checkout step → guard fails with the exact "exit 127" reason (BLOCKING #1 pin live);
   - dropped the `conclusion == "success"` filter from the script → selftest 5 assertions red + guard "conclusion-aware" test red (BLOCKING #2 pin live);
   - restored both files from backup afterward — tree identical to HEAD (`git status` clean, `git diff --check` clean).
4. Ran the full verification battery on the frozen final tree (see Test Coverage).

## Files Modified

None in this leg — all fixes were already committed on the rework head this pass verified (threads are open only as loop bookkeeping):

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — (head `67e2c4590`) unconditional blobless checkout in `release-dedupe`; comments aligned to the real deduped-twin graph.
- `scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh` — (head `67e2c4590`) conclusion-aware, fail-closed lookup (`select(.conclusion == "success")`).

# gh-1625 rework — all 12 open threads closed: verification pass on the rework head

## Issues/Notes

This rework leg continued the loop already fixed on head `67e2c4590` ("gh-1625 rework: release-dedupe checkout + conclusion-aware fail-closed dedupe"). The 12 open threads at rework start are: 1 aggregate automated review (REQUEST_CHANGES — 2 BLOCKING, 1 IMPORTANT, 2 suggestions) plus 11 machine audit/status records. **Every finding was verified against the tree, mutation-probed to prove the guards catch the flagged regressions, and the full suite was run on the final head.** No new code defects surfaced, so no further commit was needed — the open threads were loop bookkeeping on an already-fixed head (one earlier validation dispatch was lost to gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

Findings → verification (all fixed on `67e2c4590`):

1. 🚨 **BLOCKING #1 — `release-dedupe` exits 127 on every run (no checkout).** Verified present in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: an **unconditional** `actions/checkout@3d3c42e5…` (repo-wide pinned SHA, `fetch-depth: 1`, `filter: blob:none`) now precedes `run: bash scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh`. Unconditional on purpose: the `check` step has no job-level `if`, so a release-gated checkout would re-create exit 127 on the `workflow_dispatch` arm seen in runs 38696670029/38696668627.
2. 🚨 **BLOCKING #2 — any-status dedupe (fail-open).** Verified in `scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh`: the lookup fetches `--json createdAt,conclusion,status` and projects `select(.conclusion == "success")` — **only a GREEN push gate dedupes**; a failed/cancelled push run degrades to the AC2 full-gate safety net (the twin re-gates, goes red, attaches nothing). AC5 unchanged on top: API error → `::warning::` + `dedupe=false`, never a skipped gate; the script never exits non-zero.
3. ⚠️ **IMPORTANT — the guard pinned the broken shape.** Verified `test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart` no longer asserts `steps hasLength(1)` + `uses isNull`; it now pins exactly one `actions/checkout` step, unconditional, ordered before the check step, shallow + blobless.
4. 💡 **Suggestion — `isNot(contains('--status'))` pin.** Replaced by a positive pin of the fail-closed projection (`contains('--json createdAt,conclusion,status')` + `contains('select(.conclusion == "success")')`) with the corrected concurrency model (push twin completed, never `in_progress`, behind the `ci-<ref>` queue).
5. 💡 **Suggestion — "ONLY the binaries-attach leg" comment overstated.** All comments (workflow header, trigger, job, script `::notice::`) now say: every gate leg skips; binaries, `release-provenance` and `installer-smoke` still run on the deduped twin; `web-spa`/`publish` stay keyed on the quality-gate result. A guard test pins `release-provenance`/`installer-smoke` reachable with **no** dedupe clause.

Note on `outputs/review_replies.json`: every open thread in `pr_discussions_raw.json` exposes `threadId: null` / `rootCommentId: null` (copied verbatim — this PR surface exposes no resolvable IDs), so entries carry `null`; the reply files are written per thread regardless.

## Approach

1. Read the full review thread set (`pr_discussions_raw.json` — 12 open threads) and mapped each finding to the tree at head `67e2c4590`.
2. **Verified, not assumed** — read the shipped shapes directly: `release-dedupe` job (checkout present, unconditional, before the check step), dedupe script (conclusion-aware, fail-closed, AC2/AC3/AC5 paths), `binaries` dedupe arm (safe: gated on `dedupe == 'true'`, reachable only on a GREEN push gate), `release-provenance`/`installer-smoke` (release-reachable, no dedupe clause), `web-spa` (keyed on the gate result). `ci.yml` parses as valid YAML.
3. **Mutation-probed the guards (TDD proof)**: temporarily re-created each flagged defect and confirmed the suite goes red —
   - removed the checkout step → guard fails with the exact "exit 127" reason (BLOCKING #1 pin live);
   - dropped the `conclusion == "success"` filter from the script → selftest 5 assertions red + guard "conclusion-aware" test red (BLOCKING #2 pin live);
   - restored both files from backup afterward — tree identical to HEAD (`git status` clean, `git diff --check` clean).
4. Ran the full verification battery on the frozen final tree (see Test Coverage).

## Files Modified

None in this leg — all fixes were already committed on the rework head this pass verified (threads are open only as loop bookkeeping):

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — (head `67e2c4590`) unconditional blobless checkout in `release-dedupe`; comments aligned to the real deduped-twin graph.
- `scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh` — (head `67e2c4590`) conclusion-aware, fail-closed lookup (`select(.conclusion == "success")`).
- `scripts/release_dedupe_selftest.sh` — (head `67e2c4590`) fail-closed fixtures: `failure`/`cancelled`/`in_progress`/failure-among-stale-green → `dedupe=false`; lookup-shape pins; AC2/AC3/AC5 fixtures.
- `test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart` — (head `67e2c4590`) pins the working checkout contract + the fail-closed projection; no more broken-shape/`--status` pins.
- `outputs/response.md`, `outputs/review_replies.json`, `outputs/review_replies/thread_{6,7,9,10,13,14,16,18,20,22,24,26}.md` — this leg's deliverables.

## Test Coverage

- `bash scripts/release_dedupe_selftest.sh` — ✅ green (AC1 fresh-GREEN dedupe; FC fail-closed `failure`/`cancelled`/`in_progress`/mixed-red → `dedupe=false`; AC2 window-edge/old-tag/no-push-run → `dedupe=false`; AC3 push/schedule/dispatch arms dedupe=false with **zero** `gh` calls and exit 0; AC5 API failure → `::warning::` + `dedupe=false` + exit 0; lookup shape + output-file purity pinned).
- `dart test test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart test/ci_release_pending_guard_test.dart` — ✅ **22 passed** (job shape: exactly-one-unconditional-checkout-before-check, shallow+blobless; gate chain `pending == 'true' && dedupe != 'true'` across all 30 gate legs; binaries release arm; pre-check jobs excluded from the gate closure; deduped-twin release legs keep no dedupe clause; selftest wiring).
- `dart test` (full suite, bare) — run 2× in the background on the final head (`sh-21-hn8crkhd5x1i0kwo0`, `sh-41-hn8dp8sfxgftz3pk`, full logs retained). Outcome per run: every non-integration test ✅; the only failures are **environmental, proven by exact base-parity** —
  - 14 failures in `test/integration/` (headless fa-session tests: `headless_log_file`, `headless_tools_flag`, `backend_mode_cli`, `job_board_stability_pty`, `yolo_rm_critical_e2e`). Re-ran the same 5 files in isolation: **HEAD 4 passed / 14 failed; a pristine `main` worktree (base `0eeba37d9`) in the same environment: 4 passed / 14 failed — identical**. The headless fa sessions spawned by these tests collide with the live fa agent session sharing this runner; the PR diff (CI YAML + 2 bash scripts + 2 static YAML-pinning dart tests) touches no runtime code.
  - 5 failures in `test/browser_ext/` — out of the per-PR suite's scope by design (`dart_test.yaml`: browser-ext runs only in the dedicated `browser-ext.yml` workflow that builds `sw/agent.js` and supplies Chrome for Testing; neither exists on this runner).
  - Both runs also died at VM **teardown** with a native `malloc_consolidate(): unaligned fastbin chunk detected` abort (SIGABRT 134) after the last test, before the summary line — no failing test involved; the diff contains no Dart/native code, and the repo's own CI on this exact head is fully green (see below), which runs the integration suite properly sharded (`pty-integration-linux`, `--concurrency=4`).
  - **Canonical verdict**: `input/pr-1627/ci_failures.md` (written by rework setup) — "All CI checks passed on the rework head", i.e. the full gated suite on head `67e2c4590` — `static`, `pty-integration-linux`, `coverage-gate`, `guards`, et al. — is green.
- Mutation probes — ✅ both flagged defects re-created → guards red; reverted; final tree byte-identical to HEAD (`git status` clean, `git diff --check` clean).

# gh-1625 rework — all 12 open threads closed: verification pass on the rework head

## Issues/Notes

This rework leg continued the loop already fixed on head `67e2c4590` ("gh-1625 rework: release-dedupe checkout + conclusion-aware fail-closed dedupe"). The 12 open threads at rework start are: 1 aggregate automated review (REQUEST_CHANGES — 2 BLOCKING, 1 IMPORTANT, 2 suggestions) plus 11 machine audit/status records. **Every finding was verified against the tree, mutation-probed to prove the guards catch the flagged regressions, and the full suite was run on the final head.** No new code defects surfaced, so no further commit was needed — the open threads were loop bookkeeping on an already-fixed head (one earlier validation dispatch was lost to gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

Findings → verification (all fixed on `67e2c4590`):

1. 🚨 **BLOCKING #1 — `release-dedupe` exits 127 on every run (no checkout).** Verified present in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: an **unconditional** `actions/checkout@3d3c42e5…` (repo-wide pinned SHA, `fetch-depth: 1`, `filter: blob:none`) now precedes `run: bash scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh`. Unconditional on purpose: the `check` step has no job-level `if`, so a release-gated checkout would re-create exit 127 on the `workflow_dispatch` arm seen in runs 38696670029/38696668627.
2. 🚨 **BLOCKING #2 — any-status dedupe (fail-open).** Verified in `scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh`: the lookup fetches `--json createdAt,conclusion,status` and projects `select(.conclusion == "success")` — **only a GREEN push gate dedupes**; a failed/cancelled push run degrades to the AC2 full-gate safety net (the twin re-gates, goes red, attaches nothing). AC5 unchanged on top: API error → `::warning::` + `dedupe=false`, never a skipped gate; the script never exits non-zero.
3. ⚠️ **IMPORTANT — the guard pinned the broken shape.** Verified `test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart` no longer asserts `steps hasLength(1)` + `uses isNull`; it now pins exactly one `actions/checkout` step, unconditional, ordered before the check step, shallow + blobless.
4. 💡 **Suggestion — `isNot(contains('--status'))` pin.** Replaced by a positive pin of the fail-closed projection (`contains('--json createdAt,conclusion,status')` + `contains('select(.conclusion == "success")')`) with the corrected concurrency model (push twin completed, never `in_progress`, behind the `ci-<ref>` queue).
5. 💡 **Suggestion — "ONLY the binaries-attach leg" comment overstated.** All comments (workflow header, trigger, job, script `::notice::`) now say: every gate leg skips; binaries, `release-provenance` and `installer-smoke` still run on the deduped twin; `web-spa`/`publish` stay keyed on the quality-gate result. A guard test pins `release-provenance`/`installer-smoke` reachable with **no** dedupe clause.

Note on `outputs/review_replies.json`: every open thread in `pr_discussions_raw.json` exposes `threadId: null` / `rootCommentId: null` (copied verbatim — this PR surface exposes no resolvable IDs), so entries carry `null`; the reply files are written per thread regardless.

## Approach

1. Read the full review thread set (`pr_discussions_raw.json` — 12 open threads) and mapped each finding to the tree at head `67e2c4590`.
2. **Verified, not assumed** — read the shipped shapes directly: `release-dedupe` job (checkout present, unconditional, before the check step), dedupe script (conclusion-aware, fail-closed, AC2/AC3/AC5 paths), `binaries` dedupe arm (safe: gated on `dedupe == 'true'`, reachable only on a GREEN push gate), `release-provenance`/`installer-smoke` (release-reachable, no dedupe clause), `web-spa` (keyed on the gate result). `ci.yml` parses as valid YAML.
3. **Mutation-probed the guards (TDD proof)**: temporarily re-created each flagged defect and confirmed the suite goes red —
   - removed the checkout step → guard fails with the exact "exit 127" reason (BLOCKING #1 pin live);
   - dropped the `conclusion == "success"` filter from the script → selftest 5 assertions red + guard "conclusion-aware" test red (BLOCKING #2 pin live);
   - restored both files from backup afterward — tree identical to HEAD (`git status` clean, `git diff --check` clean).
4. Ran the full verification battery on the frozen final tree (see Test Coverage).

## Files Modified

None in this leg — all fixes were already committed on the rework head this pass verified (threads are open only as loop bookkeeping):

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — (head `67e2c4590`) unconditional blobless checkout in `release-dedupe`; comments aligned to the real deduped-twin graph.
- `scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh` — (head `67e2c4590`) conclusion-aware, fail-closed lookup (`select(.conclusion == "success")`).

# gh-1625 rework — all 12 open threads closed: verification pass on the rework head

## Issues/Notes

This rework leg continued the loop already fixed on head `67e2c4590` ("gh-1625 rework: release-dedupe checkout + conclusion-aware fail-closed dedupe"). The 12 open threads at rework start are: 1 aggregate automated review (REQUEST_CHANGES — 2 BLOCKING, 1 IMPORTANT, 2 suggestions) plus 11 machine audit/status records. **Every finding was verified against the tree, mutation-probed to prove the guards catch the flagged regressions, and the full suite was run on the final head.** No new code defects surfaced, so no further commit was needed — the open threads were loop bookkeeping on an already-fixed head (one earlier validation dispatch was lost to gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

Findings → verification (all fixed on `67e2c4590`):

1. 🚨 **BLOCKING #1 — `release-dedupe` exits 127 on every run (no checkout).** Verified present in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: an **unconditional** `actions/checkout@3d3c42e5…` (repo-wide pinned SHA, `fetch-depth: 1`, `filter: blob:none`) now precedes `run: bash scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh`. Unconditional on purpose: the `check` step has no job-level `if`, so a release-gated checkout would re-create exit 127 on the `workflow_dispatch` arm seen in runs 38696670029/38696668627.
2. 🚨 **BLOCKING #2 — any-status dedupe (fail-open).** Verified in `scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh`: the lookup fetches `--json createdAt,conclusion,status` and projects `select(.conclusion == "success")` — **only a GREEN push gate dedupes**; a failed/cancelled push run degrades to the AC2 full-gate safety net (the twin re-gates, goes red, attaches nothing). AC5 unchanged on top: API error → `::warning::` + `dedupe=false`, never a skipped gate; the script never exits non-zero.
3. ⚠️ **IMPORTANT — the guard pinned the broken shape.** Verified `test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart` no longer asserts `steps hasLength(1)` + `uses isNull`; it now pins exactly one `actions/checkout` step, unconditional, ordered before the check step, shallow + blobless.
4. 💡 **Suggestion — `isNot(contains('--status'))` pin.** Replaced by a positive pin of the fail-closed projection (`contains('--json createdAt,conclusion,status')` + `contains('select(.conclusion == "success")')`) with the corrected concurrency model (push twin completed, never `in_progress`, behind the `ci-<ref>` queue).
5. 💡 **Suggestion — "ONLY the binaries-attach leg" comment overstated.** All comments (workflow header, trigger, job, script `::notice::`) now say: every gate leg skips; binaries, `release-provenance` and `installer-smoke` still run on the deduped twin; `web-spa`/`publish` stay keyed on the quality-gate result. A guard test pins `release-provenance`/`installer-smoke` reachable with **no** dedupe clause.

Note on `outputs/review_replies.json`: every open thread in `pr_discussions_raw.json` exposes `threadId: null` / `rootCommentId: null` (copied verbatim — this PR surface exposes no resolvable IDs), so entries carry `null`; the reply files are written per thread regardless.

## Approach

1. Read the full review thread set (`pr_discussions_raw.json` — 12 open threads) and mapped each finding to the tree at head `67e2c4590`.
2. **Verified, not assumed** — read the shipped shapes directly: `release-dedupe` job (checkout present, unconditional, before the check step), dedupe script (conclusion-aware, fail-closed, AC2/AC3/AC5 paths), `binaries` dedupe arm (safe: gated on `dedupe == 'true'`, reachable only on a GREEN push gate), `release-provenance`/`installer-smoke` (release-reachable, no dedupe clause), `web-spa` (keyed on the gate result). `ci.yml` parses as valid YAML.
3. **Mutation-probed the guards (TDD proof)**: temporarily re-created each flagged defect and confirmed the suite goes red —
   - removed the checkout step → guard fails with the exact "exit 127" reason (BLOCKING #1 pin live);
   - dropped the `conclusion == "success"` filter from the script → selftest 5 assertions red + guard "conclusion-aware" test red (BLOCKING #2 pin live);
   - restored both files from backup afterward — tree identical to HEAD (`git status` clean, `git diff --check` clean).
4. Ran the full verification battery on the frozen final tree (see Test Coverage).

## Files Modified

None in this leg — all fixes were already committed on the rework head this pass verified (threads are open only as loop bookkeeping):

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — (head `67e2c4590`) unconditional blobless checkout in `release-dedupe`; comments aligned to the real deduped-twin graph.
- `scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh` — (head `67e2c4590`) conclusion-aware, fail-closed lookup (`select(.conclusion == "success")`).
- `scripts/release_dedupe_selftest.sh` — (head `67e2c4590`) fail-closed fixtures: `failure`/`cancelled`/`in_progress`/failure-among-stale-green → `dedupe=false`; lookup-shape pins; AC2/AC3/AC5 fixtures.
- `test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart` — (head `67e2c4590`) pins the working checkout contract + the fail-closed projection; no more broken-shape/`--status` pins.
- `outputs/response.md`, `outputs/review_replies.json`, `outputs/review_replies/thread_{6,7,9,10,13,14,16,18,20,22,24,26}.md` — this leg's deliverables.

## Test Coverage

- `bash scripts/release_dedupe_selftest.sh` — ✅ green (AC1 fresh-GREEN dedupe; FC fail-closed `failure`/`cancelled`/`in_progress`/mixed-red → `dedupe=false`; AC2 window-edge/old-tag/no-push-run → `dedupe=false`; AC3 push/schedule/dispatch arms dedupe=false with **zero** `gh` calls and exit 0; AC5 API failure → `::warning::` + `dedupe=false` + exit 0; lookup shape + output-file purity pinned).
- `dart test test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart test/ci_release_pending_guard_test.dart` — ✅ **22 passed** (job shape: exactly-one-unconditional-checkout-before-check, shallow+blobless; gate chain `pending == 'true' && dedupe != 'true'` across all 30 gate legs; binaries release arm; pre-check jobs excluded from the gate closure; deduped-twin release legs keep no dedupe clause; selftest wiring).
- `dart test` (full suite, bare) — run 2× in the background on the final head (`sh-21-hn8crkhd5x1i0kwo0`, `sh-41-hn8dp8sfxgftz3pk`, full logs retained). Outcome per run: every non-integration test ✅; the only failures are **environmental, proven by exact base-parity** —
  - 14 failures in `test/integration/` (headless fa-session tests: `headless_log_file`, `headless_tools_flag`, `backend_mode_cli`, `job_board_stability_pty`, `yolo_rm_critical_e2e`). Re-ran the same 5 files in isolation: **HEAD 4 passed / 14 failed; a pristine `main` worktree (base `0eeba37d9`) in the same environment: 4 passed / 14 failed — identical**. The headless fa sessions spawned by these tests collide with the live fa agent session sharing this runner; the PR diff (CI YAML + 2 bash scripts + 2 static YAML-pinning dart tests) touches no runtime code.
  - 5 failures in `test/browser_ext/` — out of the per-PR suite's scope by design (`dart_test.yaml`: browser-ext runs only in the dedicated `browser-ext.yml` workflow that builds `sw/agent.js` and supplies Chrome for Testing; neither exists on this runner).
  - Both runs also died at VM **teardown** with a native `malloc_consolidate(): unaligned fastbin chunk detected` abort (SIGABRT 134) after the last test, before the summary line — no failing test involved; the diff contains no Dart/native code, and the repo's own CI on this exact head is fully green (see below), which runs the integration suite properly sharded (`pty-integration-linux`, `--concurrency=4`).

- Mutation probes — ✅ both flagged defects re-created → guards red; reverted; final tree byte-identical to HEAD (`git status` clean, `git diff --check` clean).

# gh-1625 rework — all 12 open threads closed: verification pass on the rework head

## Issues/Notes

This rework leg continued the loop already fixed on head `67e2c4590` ("gh-1625 rework: release-dedupe checkout + conclusion-aware fail-closed dedupe"). The 12 open threads at rework start are: 1 aggregate automated review (REQUEST_CHANGES — 2 BLOCKING, 1 IMPORTANT, 2 suggestions) plus 11 machine audit/status records. **Every finding was verified against the tree, mutation-probed to prove the guards catch the flagged regressions, and the full suite was run on the final head.** No new code defects surfaced, so no further commit was needed — the open threads were loop bookkeeping on an already-fixed head (one earlier validation dispatch was lost to gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

Findings → verification (all fixed on `67e2c4590`):

1. 🚨 **BLOCKING #1 — `release-dedupe` exits 127 on every run (no checkout).** Verified present in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: an **unconditional** `actions/checkout@3d3c42e5…` (repo-wide pinned SHA, `fetch-depth: 1`, `filter: blob:none`) now precedes `run: bash scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh`. Unconditional on purpose: the `check` step has no job-level `if`, so a release-gated checkout would re-create exit 127 on the `workflow_dispatch` arm seen in runs 38696670029/38696668627.
2. 🚨 **BLOCKING #2 — any-status dedupe (fail-open).** Verified in `scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh`: the lookup fetches `--json createdAt,conclusion,status` and projects `select(.conclusion == "success")` — **only a GREEN push gate dedupes**; a failed/cancelled push run degrades to the AC2 full-gate safety net (the twin re-gates, goes red, attaches nothing). AC5 unchanged on top: API error → `::warning::` + `dedupe=false`, never a skipped gate; the script never exits non-zero.
3. ⚠️ **IMPORTANT — the guard pinned the broken shape.** Verified `test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart` no longer asserts `steps hasLength(1)` + `uses isNull`; it now pins exactly one `actions/checkout` step, unconditional, ordered before the check step, shallow + blobless.
4. 💡 **Suggestion — `isNot(contains('--status'))` pin.** Replaced by a positive pin of the fail-closed projection (`contains('--json createdAt,conclusion,status')` + `contains('select(.conclusion == "success")')`) with the corrected concurrency model (push twin completed, never `in_progress`, behind the `ci-<ref>` queue).
5. 💡 **Suggestion — "ONLY the binaries-attach leg" comment overstated.** All comments (workflow header, trigger, job, script `::notice::`) now say: every gate leg skips; binaries, `release-provenance` and `installer-smoke` still run on the deduped twin; `web-spa`/`publish` stay keyed on the quality-gate result. A guard test pins `release-provenance`/`installer-smoke` reachable with **no** dedupe clause.

Note on `outputs/review_replies.json`: every open thread in `pr_discussions_raw.json` exposes `threadId: null` / `rootCommentId: null` (copied verbatim — this PR surface exposes no resolvable IDs), so entries carry `null`; the reply files are written per thread regardless.

## Approach

1. Read the full review thread set (`pr_discussions_raw.json` — 12 open threads) and mapped each finding to the tree at head `67e2c4590`.
2. **Verified, not assumed** — read the shipped shapes directly: `release-dedupe` job (checkout present, unconditional, before the check step), dedupe script (conclusion-aware, fail-closed, AC2/AC3/AC5 paths), `binaries` dedupe arm (safe: gated on `dedupe == 'true'`, reachable only on a GREEN push gate), `release-provenance`/`installer-smoke` (release-reachable, no dedupe clause), `web-spa` (keyed on the gate result). `ci.yml` parses as valid YAML.
3. **Mutation-probed the guards (TDD proof)**: temporarily re-created each flagged defect and confirmed the suite goes red —
   - removed the checkout step → guard fails with the exact "exit 127" reason (BLOCKING #1 pin live);
   - dropped the `conclusion == "success"` filter from the script → selftest 5 assertions red + guard "conclusion-aware" test red (BLOCKING #2 pin live);
   - restored both files from backup afterward — tree identical to HEAD (`git status` clean, `git diff --check` clean).
4. Ran the full verification battery on the frozen final tree (see Test Coverage).

## Files Modified

None in this leg — all fixes were already committed on the rework head this pass verified (threads are open only as loop bookkeeping):

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — (head `67e2c4590`) unconditional blobless checkout in `release-dedupe`; comments aligned to the real deduped-twin graph.
- `scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh` — (head `67e2c4590`) conclusion-aware, fail-closed lookup (`select(.conclusion == "success")`).
- `scripts/release_dedupe_selftest.sh` — (head `67e2c4590`) fail-closed fixtures: `failure`/`cancelled`/`in_progress`/failure-among-stale-green → `dedupe=false`; lookup-shape pins; AC2/AC3/AC5 fixtures.
- `test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart` — (head `67e2c4590`) pins the working checkout contract + the fail-closed projection; no more broken-shape/`--status` pins.
- `outputs/response.md`, `outputs/review_replies.json`, `outputs/review_replies/thread_{6,7,9,10,13,14,16,18,20,22,24,26}.md` — this leg's deliverables.

## Test Coverage

- `bash scripts/release_dedupe_selftest.sh` — ✅ green (AC1 fresh-GREEN dedupe; FC fail-closed `failure`/`cancelled`/`in_progress`/mixed-red → `dedupe=false`; AC2 window-edge/old-tag/no-push-run → `dedupe=false`; AC3 push/schedule/dispatch arms dedupe=false with **zero** `gh` calls and exit 0; AC5 API failure → `::warning::` + `dedupe=false` + exit 0; lookup shape + output-file purity pinned).
- `dart test test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart test/ci_release_pending_guard_test.dart` — ✅ **22 passed** (job shape: exactly-one-unconditional-checkout-before-check, shallow+blobless; gate chain `pending == 'true' && dedupe != 'true'` across all 30 gate legs; binaries release arm; pre-check jobs excluded from the gate closure; deduped-twin release legs keep no dedupe clause; selftest wiring).
- `dart test` (full suite, bare) — run 2× in the background on the final head (`sh-21-hn8crkhd5x1i0kwo0`, `sh-41-hn8dp8sfxgftz3pk`, full logs retained). Outcome per run: every non-integration test ✅; the only failures are **environmental, proven by exact base-parity** —
  - 14 failures in `test/integration/` (headless fa-session tests: `headless_log_file`, `headless_tools_flag`, `backend_mode_cli`, `job_board_stability_pty`, `yolo_rm_critical_e2e`). Re-ran the same 5 files in isolation: **HEAD 4 passed / 14 failed; a pristine `main` worktree (base `0eeba37d9`) in the same environment: 4 passed / 14 failed — identical**. The headless fa sessions spawned by these tests collide with the live fa agent session sharing this runner; the PR diff (CI YAML + 2 bash scripts + 2 static YAML-pinning dart tests) touches no runtime code.
  - 5 failures in `test/browser_ext/` — out of the per-PR suite's scope by design (`dart_test.yaml`: browser-ext runs only in the dedicated `browser-ext.yml` workflow that builds `sw/agent.js` and supplies Chrome for Testing; neither exists on this runner).
  - Both runs also died at VM **teardown** with a native `malloc_consolidate(): unaligned fastbin chunk detected` abort (SIGABRT 134) after the last test, before the summary line — no failing test involved; the diff contains no Dart/native code, and the repo's own CI on this exact head is fully green (see below), which runs the integration suite properly sharded (`pty-integration-linux`, `--concurrency=4`).

- Mutation probes — ✅ both flagged defects re-created → guards red; reverted; final tree byte-identical to HEAD (`git status` clean, `git diff --check` clean).

# gh-1625 rework — all 12 open threads closed: verification pass on the rework head

## Issues/Notes

This rework leg continued the loop already fixed on head `67e2c4590` ("gh-1625 rework: release-dedupe checkout + conclusion-aware fail-closed dedupe"). The 12 open threads at rework start are: 1 aggregate automated review (REQUEST_CHANGES — 2 BLOCKING, 1 IMPORTANT, 2 suggestions) plus 11 machine audit/status records. **Every finding was verified against the tree, mutation-probed to prove the guards catch the flagged regressions, and the full suite was run on the final head.** No new code defects surfaced, so no further commit was needed — the open threads were loop bookkeeping on an already-fixed head (one earlier validation dispatch was lost to gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

Findings → verification (all fixed on `67e2c4590`):

1. 🚨 **BLOCKING #1 — `release-dedupe` exits 127 on every run (no checkout).** Verified present in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: an **unconditional** `actions/checkout@3d3c42e5…` (repo-wide pinned SHA, `fetch-depth: 1`, `filter: blob:none`) now precedes `run: bash scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh`. Unconditional on purpose: the `check` step has no job-level `if`, so a release-gated checkout would re-create exit 127 on the `workflow_dispatch` arm seen in runs 38696670029/38696668627.
2. 🚨 **BLOCKING #2 — any-status dedupe (fail-open).** Verified in `scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh`: the lookup fetches `--json createdAt,conclusion,status` and projects `select(.conclusion == "success")` — **only a GREEN push gate dedupes**; a failed/cancelled push run degrades to the AC2 full-gate safety net (the twin re-gates, goes red, attaches nothing). AC5 unchanged on top: API error → `::warning::` + `dedupe=false`, never a skipped gate; the script never exits non-zero.
3. ⚠️ **IMPORTANT — the guard pinned the broken shape.** Verified `test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart` no longer asserts `steps hasLength(1)` + `uses isNull`; it now pins exactly one `actions/checkout` step, unconditional, ordered before the check step, shallow + blobless.
4. 💡 **Suggestion — `isNot(contains('--status'))` pin.** Replaced by a positive pin of the fail-closed projection (`contains('--json createdAt,conclusion,status')` + `contains('select(.conclusion == "success")')`) with the corrected concurrency model (push twin completed, never `in_progress`, behind the `ci-<ref>` queue).
5. 💡 **Suggestion — "ONLY the binaries-attach leg" comment overstated.** All comments (workflow header, trigger, job, script `::notice::`) now say: every gate leg skips; binaries, `release-provenance` and `installer-smoke` still run on the deduped twin; `web-spa`/`publish` stay keyed on the quality-gate result. A guard test pins `release-provenance`/`installer-smoke` reachable with **no** dedupe clause.

Note on `outputs/review_replies.json`: every open thread in `pr_discussions_raw.json` exposes `threadId: null` / `rootCommentId: null` (copied verbatim — this PR surface exposes no resolvable IDs), so entries carry `null`; the reply files are written per thread regardless.

## Approach

1. Read the full review thread set (`pr_discussions_raw.json` — 12 open threads) and mapped each finding to the tree at head `67e2c4590`.
2. **Verified, not assumed** — read the shipped shapes directly: `release-dedupe` job (checkout present, unconditional, before the check step), dedupe script (conclusion-aware, fail-closed, AC2/AC3/AC5 paths), `binaries` dedupe arm (safe: gated on `dedupe == 'true'`, reachable only on a GREEN push gate), `release-provenance`/`installer-smoke` (release-reachable, no dedupe clause), `web-spa` (keyed on the gate result). `ci.yml` parses as valid YAML.
3. **Mutation-probed the guards (TDD proof)**: temporarily re-created each flagged defect and confirmed the suite goes red —
   - removed the checkout step → guard fails with the exact "exit 127" reason (BLOCKING #1 pin live);
   - dropped the `conclusion == "success"` filter from the script → selftest 5 assertions red + guard "conclusion-aware" test red (BLOCKING #2 pin live);
   - restored both files from backup afterward — tree identical to HEAD (`git status` clean, `git diff --check` clean).
4. Ran the full verification battery on the frozen final tree (see Test Coverage).

## Files Modified

None in this leg — all fixes were already committed on the rework head this pass verified (threads are open only as loop bookkeeping):

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — (head `67e2c4590`) unconditional blobless checkout in `release-dedupe`; comments aligned to the real deduped-twin graph.
- `scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh` — (head `67e2c4590`) conclusion-aware, fail-closed lookup (`select(.conclusion == "success")`).
- `scripts/release_dedupe_selftest.sh` — (head `67e2c4590`) fail-closed fixtures: `failure`/`cancelled`/`in_progress`/failure-among-stale-green → `dedupe=false`; lookup-shape pins; AC2/AC3/AC5 fixtures.
- `test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart` — (head `67e2c4590`) pins the working checkout contract + the fail-closed projection; no more broken-shape/`--status` pins.
- `outputs/response.md`, `outputs/review_replies.json`, `outputs/review_replies/thread_{6,7,9,10,13,14,16,18,20,22,24,26}.md` — this leg's deliverables.

## Test Coverage

- `bash scripts/release_dedupe_selftest.sh` — ✅ green (AC1 fresh-GREEN dedupe; FC fail-closed `failure`/`cancelled`/`in_progress`/mixed-red → `dedupe=false`; AC2 window-edge/old-tag/no-push-run → `dedupe=false`; AC3 push/schedule/dispatch arms dedupe=false with **zero** `gh` calls and exit 0; AC5 API failure → `::warning::` + `dedupe=false` + exit 0; lookup shape + output-file purity pinned).
- `dart test test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart test/ci_release_pending_guard_test.dart` — ✅ **22 passed** (job shape: exactly-one-unconditional-checkout-before-check, shallow+blobless; gate chain `pending == 'true' && dedupe != 'true'` across all 30 gate legs; binaries release arm; pre-check jobs excluded from the gate closure; deduped-twin release legs keep no dedupe clause; selftest wiring).
- `dart test` (full suite, bare) — run 2× in the background on the final head (`sh-21-hn8crkhd5x1i0kwo0`, `sh-41-hn8dp8sfxgftz3pk`, full logs retained). Outcome per run: every non-integration test ✅; the only failures are **environmental, proven by exact base-parity** —
  - 14 failures in `test/integration/` (headless fa-session tests: `headless_log_file`, `headless_tools_flag`, `backend_mode_cli`, `job_board_stability_pty`, `yolo_rm_critical_e2e`). Re-ran the same 5 files in isolation: **HEAD 4 passed / 14 failed; a pristine `main` worktree (base `0eeba37d9`) in the same environment: 4 passed / 14 failed — identical**. The headless fa sessions spawned by these tests collide with the live fa agent session sharing this runner; the PR diff (CI YAML + 2 bash scripts + 2 static YAML-pinning dart tests) touches no runtime code.
  - 5 failures in `test/browser_ext/` — out of the per-PR suite's scope by design (`dart_test.yaml`: browser-ext runs only in the dedicated `browser-ext.yml` workflow that builds `sw/agent.js` and supplies Chrome for Testing; neither exists on this runner).
  - Both runs also died at VM **teardown** with a native `malloc_consolidate(): unaligned fastbin chunk detected` abort (SIGABRT 134) after the last test, before the summary line — no failing test involved; the diff contains no Dart/native code, and the repo's own CI on this exact head is fully green (see below), which runs the integration suite properly sharded (`pty-integration-linux`, `--concurrency=4`).
  - **Canonical verdict**: `input/pr-1627/ci_failures.md` (written by rework setup) — "All CI checks passed on the rework head", i.e. the full gated suite on head `67e2c4590` — `static`, `pty-integration-linux`, `coverage-gate`, `guards`, et al. — is green.
- Mutation probes — ✅ both flagged defects re-created → guards red; reverted; final tree byte-identical to HEAD (`git status` clean, `git diff --check` clean).

# gh-1625 rework — all 12 open threads closed: verification pass on the rework head

## Issues/Notes

This rework leg continued the loop already fixed on head `67e2c4590` ("gh-1625 rework: release-dedupe checkout + conclusion-aware fail-closed dedupe"). The 12 open threads at rework start are: 1 aggregate automated review (REQUEST_CHANGES — 2 BLOCKING, 1 IMPORTANT, 2 suggestions) plus 11 machine audit/status records. **Every finding was verified against the tree, mutation-probed to prove the guards catch the flagged regressions, and the full suite was run on the final head.** No new code defects surfaced, so no further commit was needed — the open threads were loop bookkeeping on an already-fixed head (one earlier validation dispatch was lost to gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

Findings → verification (all fixed on `67e2c4590`):

1. 🚨 **BLOCKING #1 — `release-dedupe` exits 127 on every run (no checkout).** Verified present in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: an **unconditional** `actions/checkout@3d3c42e5…` (repo-wide pinned SHA, `fetch-depth: 1`, `filter: blob:none`) now precedes `run: bash scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh`. Unconditional on purpose: the `check` step has no job-level `if`, so a release-gated checkout would re-create exit 127 on the `workflow_dispatch` arm seen in runs 38696670029/38696668627.
2. 🚨 **BLOCKING #2 — any-status dedupe (fail-open).** Verified in `scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh`: the lookup fetches `--json createdAt,conclusion,status` and projects `select(.conclusion == "success")` — **only a GREEN push gate dedupes**; a failed/cancelled push run degrades to the AC2 full-gate safety net (the twin re-gates, goes red, attaches nothing). AC5 unchanged on top: API error → `::warning::` + `dedupe=false`, never a skipped gate; the script never exits non-zero.
3. ⚠️ **IMPORTANT — the guard pinned the broken shape.** Verified `test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart` no longer asserts `steps hasLength(1)` + `uses isNull`; it now pins exactly one `actions/checkout` step, unconditional, ordered before the check step, shallow + blobless.
4. 💡 **Suggestion — `isNot(contains('--status'))` pin.** Replaced by a positive pin of the fail-closed projection (`contains('--json createdAt,conclusion,status')` + `contains('select(.conclusion == "success")')`) with the corrected concurrency model (push twin completed, never `in_progress`, behind the `ci-<ref>` queue).
5. 💡 **Suggestion — "ONLY the binaries-attach leg" comment overstated.** All comments (workflow header, trigger, job, script `::notice::`) now say: every gate leg skips; binaries, `release-provenance` and `installer-smoke` still run on the deduped twin; `web-spa`/`publish` stay keyed on the quality-gate result. A guard test pins `release-provenance`/`installer-smoke` reachable with **no** dedupe clause.

Note on `outputs/review_replies.json`: every open thread in `pr_discussions_raw.json` exposes `threadId: null` / `rootCommentId: null` (copied verbatim — this PR surface exposes no resolvable IDs), so entries carry `null`; the reply files are written per thread regardless.

## Approach

1. Read the full review thread set (`pr_discussions_raw.json` — 12 open threads) and mapped each finding to the tree at head `67e2c4590`.
2. **Verified, not assumed** — read the shipped shapes directly: `release-dedupe` job (checkout present, unconditional, before the check step), dedupe script (conclusion-aware, fail-closed, AC2/AC3/AC5 paths), `binaries` dedupe arm (safe: gated on `dedupe == 'true'`, reachable only on a GREEN push gate), `release-provenance`/`installer-smoke` (release-reachable, no dedupe clause), `web-spa` (keyed on the gate result). `ci.yml` parses as valid YAML.
3. **Mutation-probed the guards (TDD proof)**: temporarily re-created each flagged defect and confirmed the suite goes red —
   - removed the checkout step → guard fails with the exact "exit 127" reason (BLOCKING #1 pin live);
   - dropped the `conclusion == "success"` filter from the script → selftest 5 assertions red + guard "conclusion-aware" test red (BLOCKING #2 pin live);
   - restored both files from backup afterward — tree identical to HEAD (`git status` clean, `git diff --check` clean).
4. Ran the full verification battery on the frozen final tree (see Test Coverage).

## Files Modified

None in this leg — all fixes were already committed on the rework head this pass verified (threads are open only as loop bookkeeping):

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — (head `67e2c4590`) unconditional blobless checkout in `release-dedupe`; comments aligned to the real deduped-twin graph.
- `scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh` — (head `67e2c4590`) conclusion-aware, fail-closed lookup (`select(.conclusion == "success")`).
- `scripts/release_dedupe_selftest.sh` — (head `67e2c4590`) fail-closed fixtures: `failure`/`cancelled`/`in_progress`/failure-among-stale-green → `dedupe=false`; lookup-shape pins; AC2/AC3/AC5 fixtures.
- `test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart` — (head `67e2c4590`) pins the working checkout contract + the fail-closed projection; no more broken-shape/`--status` pins.
- `outputs/response.md`, `outputs/review_replies.json`, `outputs/review_replies/thread_{6,7,9,10,13,14,16,18,20,22,24,26}.md` — this leg's deliverables.

## Test Coverage

- `bash scripts/release_dedupe_selftest.sh` — ✅ green (AC1 fresh-GREEN dedupe; FC fail-closed `failure`/`cancelled`/`in_progress`/mixed-red → `dedupe=false`; AC2 window-edge/old-tag/no-push-run → `dedupe=false`; AC3 push/schedule/dispatch arms dedupe=false with **zero** `gh` calls and exit 0; AC5 API failure → `::warning::` + `dedupe=false` + exit 0; lookup shape + output-file purity pinned).
- `dart test test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart test/ci_release_pending_guard_test.dart` — ✅ **22 passed** (job shape: exactly-one-unconditional-checkout-before-check, shallow+blobless; gate chain `pending == 'true' && dedupe != 'true'` across all 30 gate legs; binaries release arm; pre-check jobs excluded from the gate closure; deduped-twin release legs keep no dedupe clause; selftest wiring).
- `dart test` (full suite, bare) — run 2× in the background on the final head (`sh-21-hn8crkhd5x1i0kwo0`, `sh-41-hn8dp8sfxgftz3pk`, full logs retained). Outcome per run: every non-integration test ✅; the only failures are **environmental, proven by exact base-parity** —
  - 14 failures in `test/integration/` (headless fa-session tests: `headless_log_file`, `headless_tools_flag`, `backend_mode_cli`, `job_board_stability_pty`, `yolo_rm_critical_e2e`). Re-ran the same 5 files in isolation: **HEAD 4 passed / 14 failed; a pristine `main` worktree (base `0eeba37d9`) in the same environment: 4 passed / 14 failed — identical**. The headless fa sessions spawned by these tests collide with the live fa agent session sharing this runner; the PR diff (CI YAML + 2 bash scripts + 2 static YAML-pinning dart tests) touches no runtime code.
  - 5 failures in `test/browser_ext/` — out of the per-PR suite's scope by design (`dart_test.yaml`: browser-ext runs only in the dedicated `browser-ext.yml` workflow that builds `sw/agent.js` and supplies Chrome for Testing; neither exists on this runner).
  - Both runs also died at VM **teardown** with a native `malloc_consolidate(): unaligned fastbin chunk detected` abort (SIGABRT 134) after the last test, before the summary line — no failing test involved; the diff contains no Dart/native code, and the repo's own CI on this exact head is fully green (see below), which runs the integration suite properly sharded (`pty-integration-linux`, `--concurrency=4`).
  - **Canonical verdict**: `input/pr-1627/ci_failures.md` (written by rework setup) — "All CI checks passed on the rework head", i.e. the full gated suite on head `67e2c4590` — `static`, `pty-integration-linux`, `coverage-gate`, `guards`, et al. — is green.
- Mutation probes — ✅ both flagged defects re-created → guards red; reverted; final tree byte-identical to HEAD (`git status` clean, `git diff --check` clean).
